home.tagline: Build reactive custom elements with a React-like API, native browser primitives, SSR, islands hydration, and styles that stay out of the way.
home.intro_title: Wompo turns small functions into portable UI primitives.
home.intro_body: Define a component once, render it as a real custom element, and reuse it in static HTML, Wompo apps, SSR pages, or alongside React, Vue, Angular, and plain JavaScript.
home.demo_title: Write components as functions. Ship them as HTML elements.
home.demo_body: State, events, children, refs, context, CSS modules, lazy components, portals, and SSR all use a compact API designed for productive front-end work.
home.features_title: Modern Web Components with fewer moving parts.
home.features_body: Wompo keeps the native element model, but gives developers the ergonomics they expect from component libraries.

native.title: Works in any stack
native.body: A Wompo component is still a real custom element, so it can be dropped into existing pages and mixed with other frameworks.

reactive.title: Hooks and dynamic DOM
reactive.body: Use familiar hooks such as useState, useEffect, useMemo, and context to keep UI state explicit and local.

css.title: CSS modules built in
css.body: Class names can be scoped automatically, so components remain predictable without forcing Shadow DOM by default.

ssr.title: Server rendering and islands
ssr.body: Render the same components on the server, then hydrate only the islands that need client-side behavior.

portable.title: No mandatory bundler
portable.body: Install from npm, use an import map, load from a CDN, or ship a single component where it is needed.

typed.title: TypeScript friendly
typed.body: The core is written with TypeScript and exposes component, props, element, and render helper types.

home.workflow_title: A small workflow for real UI work.

workflow.install_body: Add Wompo with npm or map it directly in the browser.
workflow.compose_body: Create components with functions, hooks, events, children, and local styles.
workflow.ship_body: Render as Web Components, hydrate on demand, and reuse across projects.

home.cta_title: Start with a component, not a framework migration.
home.cta_body: The docs include quick examples, API references, SSR guidance, hooks, and practical patterns for building with Wompo.
